title: Software Developer
summary: Build websites, apps and systems that people use every day.

roadmap.title: Learn programming basics (JavaScript or Python)
Learn data structures and algorithms
Build 3-4 real projects and put them on GitHub
Apply for internships and junior roles

expect: Constant learning as tools change
Problem solving most of the day
Remote and hybrid options are common

title: Data Analyst
summary: Turn raw numbers into insights that help businesses decide.

roadmap.title: Learn Excel and SQL
Learn Python (pandas) or R and statistics basics
Learn a dashboard tool like Power BI or Tableau
Build a portfolio of 3 analysis projects

exams: No mandatory exam; a degree in any quantitative field helps
expect: Lots of spreadsheet and SQL work
Explaining findings to non-technical people
Clean data takes more time than analysis

title: UI/UX Designer
summary: Design apps and websites that are easy and pleasant to use.

roadmap.title: Learn design basics: layout, color, typography
Learn Figma and prototyping
Learn user research and usability testing
Build a portfolio with 3 case studies

exams: NID DAT, UCEED (for design degrees; optional)
expect: Your portfolio matters more than your degree
Feedback and revisions all the time
Working closely with developers

title: Digital Marketer
summary: Help brands find and keep customers through search, social media and ads.

roadmap.title: Learn marketing basics and how SEO works
Learn social media and paid ads (Google, Meta)
Learn analytics (Google Analytics)
Run a real campaign for a small business or your own page

expect: Results are measured in numbers
Platforms and algorithms keep changing
Creative work mixed with reports

title: Chartered Accountant
summary: Handle accounting, tax, audit and financial advice for businesses.

roadmap.title: Register for CA Foundation after 12th
Clear CA Intermediate and start articleship
Complete 3 years of articleship training
Clear CA Final and become a member of ICAI

expect: A long and demanding course
Busy seasons around tax deadlines
Strong demand once qualified

title: Doctor (MBBS)
summary: Diagnose and treat patients, and specialise in a field of medicine.

roadmap.title: Take Physics, Chemistry and Biology in 11th-12th
Clear NEET-UG and get a medical seat
Complete MBBS including internship
Prepare for NEET-PG to specialise (MD/MS)

expect: Very competitive entry
Long years of study and training
Long hours, but deeply meaningful work

title: School Teacher
summary: Teach and guide students in school, and shape how they learn.

roadmap.title: Complete a bachelor's degree in your subject
Complete a B.Ed. degree
Clear TET and CTET
Apply to government or private schools

expect: Stable job, especially in government schools
Work beyond classroom hours
Rewarding when students succeed

title: Lawyer
summary: Advise clients and argue cases in court or in a company's legal team.

roadmap.title: Prepare for CLAT after 12th
Complete a 5-year integrated law degree (BA LLB)
Intern with courts, law firms and companies
Register with the Bar Council and start practice or join a firm

expect: A lot of reading and writing
Slow early years, big growth later
Pay varies hugely between firms and courts

title: Civil Services Officer
summary: Work in government to run districts, policy and public services (IAS, IPS, IFS).

roadmap.title: Complete any bachelor's degree
Understand the UPSC syllabus and build a study plan
Prepare for Prelims, Mains and Interview
Train at the academy and take up your first posting

exams: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, Mains, Interview)
expect: Very low selection rate, so have a backup plan
Job security and authority
Transfers and demanding responsibility

title: Content Writer
summary: Write articles, scripts, ads and website copy for brands and publications.

roadmap.title: Read widely and practise writing every day
Learn SEO and how to write for the web
Start a blog or write guest posts to build samples
Apply for freelance gigs and junior writer roles

exams: No mandatory exam; a degree in English or journalism helps
expect: Deadlines are frequent
Freelance income can be uneven at first
AI tools are changing the work, so strong ideas matter
